_meta.primary_source: WHO IMCI Chart Booklet (Integrated Management of Childhood Illness), 2014 revision
_meta.secondary_source: Kenya IMCI National Guidelines, Ministry of Health, 2016
_meta.scope: Children aged 2 months to 59 months (2 months to <5 years)
_meta.note: Rules encoded from chart booklet by hand. Each rule ID matches the predicate in rules_engine.dart. Verify every page reference against the physical PDF before a clinical deployment.

rules.action: Refer URGENTLY to hospital
rules.passage: A child has a general danger sign if the child: is having convulsions now. Refer URGENTLY to hospital.

rules.action: Refer URGENTLY to hospital
rules.passage: A child has a general danger sign if the child: is lethargic or unconscious. Refer URGENTLY to hospital.

rules.action: Refer URGENTLY to hospital
rules.passage: A child has a general danger sign if the child: is not able to drink or breastfeed. Refer URGENTLY to hospital.

rules.action: Refer URGENTLY to hospital
rules.passage: A child has a general danger sign if the child: vomits everything. Refer URGENTLY to hospital.

rules.classification: SEVERE PNEUMONIA OR VERY SEVERE DISEASE
rules.action: Refer URGENTLY. Give first dose of antibiotic.

source.label: IMCI Chart 2 – Cough or Difficult Breathing

rules.passage: Classify as SEVERE PNEUMONIA OR VERY SEVERE DISEASE if: central cyanosis. Refer URGENTLY to hospital.

rules.classification: SEVERE PNEUMONIA OR VERY SEVERE DISEASE
rules.action: Refer URGENTLY. Give first dose of amoxicillin.

source.label: IMCI Chart 2 – Cough or Difficult Breathing

rules.passage: Classify as SEVERE PNEUMONIA OR VERY SEVERE DISEASE if: chest indrawing. Refer URGENTLY to hospital. Give first dose of appropriate antibiotic.

rules.classification: SEVERE PNEUMONIA OR VERY SEVERE DISEASE
rules.action: Refer URGENTLY to hospital.

source.label: IMCI Chart 2 – Cough or Difficult Breathing

rules.passage: Classify as SEVERE PNEUMONIA OR VERY SEVERE DISEASE if: stridor in calm child. Refer URGENTLY to hospital.

findings: Two or more signs of severe dehydration
rules.action: Refer URGENTLY with ongoing ORS. Give ORS on the way.
rules.passage: Classify as SEVERE DEHYDRATION if two of the following: lethargic or unconscious; sunken eyes; not able to drink or drinks poorly; skin pinch goes back very slowly (>2 s). Refer URGENTLY to hospital with ORS.

rules.action: Refer URGENTLY. Give first dose of antibiotic and antipyretic.
rules.passage: Classify as VERY SEVERE FEBRILE DISEASE if: stiff neck. Refer URGENTLY. Give first dose of antibiotic and antipyretic.

rules.action: Refer URGENTLY.
rules.passage: Classify as VERY SEVERE FEBRILE DISEASE if: bulging fontanelle (in infant). Refer URGENTLY.

rules.action: Refer URGENTLY to hospital.
rules.passage: Classify as MASTOIDITIS if: tender swelling behind the ear. Refer URGENTLY to hospital.

rules.action: Refer URGENTLY for inpatient nutrition management.
rules.passage: Classify as SEVERE ACUTE MALNUTRITION if: visible severe wasting. Refer URGENTLY for inpatient nutrition management.

findings: Bilateral pitting oedema of both feet (kwashiorkor)
rules.action: Refer URGENTLY.
rules.passage: Classify as SEVERE ACUTE MALNUTRITION if: oedema of both feet. Refer URGENTLY.

rules.action: Refer URGENTLY for therapeutic feeding.
rules.passage: Classify as SEVERE ACUTE MALNUTRITION if: MUAC < 115 mm. Refer URGENTLY for therapeutic feeding.

rules.action: Refer URGENTLY. Give Vitamin A.
rules.passage: Classify as SEVERE ANAEMIA if: severe palmar pallor. Refer URGENTLY. Give Vitamin A.

rules.action: Give oral amoxicillin for 5 days. Follow up in 2 days.

source.label: IMCI Chart 2 – Cough or Difficult Breathing

rules.passage: Classify as PNEUMONIA if: fast breathing (≥50 bpm if age 2–11 months; ≥40 bpm if 12–59 months) and no chest indrawing or stridor. Give oral amoxicillin for 5 days. Follow up in 2 days.

rules.action: Give ciprofloxacin for 3 days. Follow up in 2 days.
rules.passage: Classify as DYSENTERY if: blood in the stool. Give ciprofloxacin for 3 days. Follow up in 2 days.

rules.action: Refer for assessment. Advise the mother on feeding.
rules.passage: Classify as PERSISTENT DIARRHOEA if: diarrhoea for 14 days or more. Refer for assessment. Advise the mother on feeding.

findings: Two or more signs of some dehydration
rules.action: Give ORS solution (Plan B). Follow up in 2 days.
rules.passage: Classify as SOME DEHYDRATION if two of the following: restless or irritable; sunken eyes; drinks eagerly/thirsty; skin pinch goes back slowly (1–2 s). Give ORS solution (Plan B). Follow up in 2 days.

rules.action: Give artemether-lumefantrine (AL) per weight band for 3 days. Give antipyretic. Follow up in 2 days.
rules.passage: Classify as MALARIA if: fever and positive malaria RDT (in malaria-risk area). Give artemether-lumefantrine (AL) for 3 days per weight band. Give antipyretic. Follow up in 2 days if not improving.

findings: Pus draining from ear < 14 days OR ear pain
rules.action: Give amoxicillin for 5 days. Dry ear by wicking. Follow up in 5 days.
rules.passage: Classify as ACUTE EAR INFECTION if: pus draining < 14 days OR ear pain. Give amoxicillin for 5 days. Dry the ear by wicking. Follow up in 5 days.

rules.action: Provide supplementary food (RUSF). Counsel on feeding. Follow up in 30 days.
rules.passage: Classify as MODERATE ACUTE MALNUTRITION if: MUAC 115 mm to <125 mm. Provide supplementary food (RUSF). Counsel on feeding. Follow up in 30 days.

rules.action: Give iron and folic acid. Give anthelmintic if age ≥12 months. Follow up in 14 days.
rules.passage: Classify as ANAEMIA if: some palmar pallor. Give iron and folic acid. Give anthelmintic if age ≥12 months. Advise to return if condition worsens. Follow up in 14 days.

rules.action: Dry the ear by wicking. Follow up in 5 days. Refer if no improvement.
rules.passage: Classify as CHRONIC EAR INFECTION if: pus draining ≥ 14 days. Dry the ear by wicking. Follow up in 5 days. Refer if no improvement.

findings: Cough with no fast breathing, no chest indrawing, no stridor
rules.action: Soothe the throat. Return if not improving in 5 days.

source.label: IMCI Chart 2 – Cough or Difficult Breathing

rules.passage: No signs of pneumonia or very severe disease. Soothe the throat and relieve the cough with a safe remedy. Advise the mother to return if the child is not improving in 5 days.

rules.action: Give extra fluid and continue feeding (Plan A). Return if worsens.
rules.passage: No signs of dehydration. Give extra fluid and continue feeding (Plan A). Advise mother to return if the child is not improving in 2 days or develops any danger sign.

rules.action: Give antipyretic. Return if not improving in 2 days.
rules.passage: Classify as FEVER — NO MALARIA if: fever and negative malaria RDT, fever <7 days, and no other severe classification. Give antipyretic. Advise to return if not improving in 2 days.
